reason: The goal calls for a chisel, and iron and stone seem suitable for making and shaping a cutting tool.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making the saw was most worthwhile because the explanation showed how its teeth are cut and set to clear the blade's path.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the reservoir to the channel was straightforward but gave little detail beyond the resulting name.

surprise.text: I was surprised that sawing wood produced a bored water pipe; the explanation clarified how it was made.

continue.text: I would continue to see what other practical systems the settlement builds; the irrigation sequence and its explanations held my interest.
